Ruled by the orchestrator (D152, D134 of the 4v4 log for the 8 upcast rows). The hireling learned 5 spells it hasn't prepared, with their upcast rows; a twin holds its prepared picks only, which is what a Wizard can cast in an arena: it can't re-prepare in a fight and no rest happens. Read 5 (website ops/logs/live.md, 'Unlock probe and owed scratch reads', 2026-11-07): the twin refuses Witch Bolt, a spell outside its picks.

Ruled by the orchestrator (D152). The same rows as `spells`, and a twin's book rows are AlwaysPrepared where a Wizard's are RequiresPreparation, with the same ability, DC and attack; a twin can't change what it holds in a fight.

Ruled by the orchestrator (D183, D140 of the 4v4 log). Arcane Recovery's upcast rows: a class row gives a twin the spell, so the kit adds these two by AddSpell, and an AddSpell'd row reads in `prepared`. It's a class resource spell with nothing to prepare, the reference holds both rows in `spells`, and an extra `prepared` row stopped no upcast and took no wrong slot (website ops/logs/live.md, 'Unlock probe and owed scratch reads', 2026-11-07).
